lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exists t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs => exact Or.inl (.abs der'.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (.tabs der'.wf.2.1)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq <;> have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r il ir =>
    cases lc
    rcases il rfl l with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
    all_goals rcases ir rfl r with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have b := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals aesop (add 50% constructors Value, 50% constructors Red)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq <;> have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r il ir =>
    cases lc
    rcases il rfl l with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
    all_goals rcases ir rfl r with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have b := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals try solve_by_elim [Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, Value.abs, Value.tabs,
    Value.inl, Value.inr, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tapp, Red.tabs,
    Red.let_body, Red.let_bind, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq <;> have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r il ir =>
    cases lc
    rcases il rfl l with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
    all_goals rcases ir rfl r with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have b := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals solve_by_elim [Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, Value.abs, Value.tabs,
    Value.inl, Value.inr, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tapp, Red.tabs,
    Red.let_body, Red.let_bind, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq <;> have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r il ir =>
    cases lc
    rcases il rfl l with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
    all_goals rcases ir rfl r with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have b := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | exact .inl (by constructor; assumption)
    | refine .inr ?_
      solve_by_elim [Exists.intro, Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tapp, Red.tabs,
        Red.let_body, Red.let_bind, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih (by assumption) rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir (by assumption) rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | exact .inl (by constructor; assumption)
    | refine .inr ?_
      solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih (by assumption) rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir (by assumption) rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | exact .inl (by constructor; assumption)
    | refine .inr ⟨_, ?_⟩
      solve_by_elim only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih (by assumption) rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir (by assumption) rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | exact .inl (by constructor; assumption)
    | refine .inr ?_
      aesop (add unsafe constructors Red)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | refine .inr ?_
      solve_by_elim (intro := false) only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih lc rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    try simp only [body_let, body_case] at lc
    cases lc
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.intro.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | clear ih der
      right; apply Exists.intro
      aesop (add 50% constructors Red)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> cases eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih this rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases this
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | refine .inr ?_
      solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

  have := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> cases eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih this rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases this
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.refl.app.inl =>

  case' case.refl.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | refine .inr ?_

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => contradiction
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih this rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases this
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => contradiction
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih this rfl
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases this
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | right
      solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) [Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]
